Definition: Estrus Detection Rate (percent) -- The percentage of total heifers in estrus that are detected in the ED (Estrus Detection) protocol
Estrus Conception Rate (percent) -- The percentage of inseminated heifers that become pregnant in the ED (Estrus Detection) protocol

"The hormone delivery program to be used for heifers using the Synch-ED or TAI repro method. If the Synch-ED method is used, this value must be "2p" or "CP". When the TAI method is used, this value must be "5dCG2P", or "5dCGP". When the ED protocol is used, this value should set it to N/A"
Conception Rate -- The conception rate for the heifer reproductive program subprotocol (default is 0.6)
Estrus Detection Rate -- The % of in-heat animals that would be detected in the heifer reproductive program subprotocol  (default is 0.6)
